notes.title: New game mechanic, new bonus levels, and new lower price!
notes.content:
Excited to announce the first major update to [i][b]Rocococo Audiogame[/b][/i] that adds a brand new game mechanic  --> [b]throwing cake![/b] <-- and includes --> [b]2 new bonus levels[/b] <-- that use this fun cake-throwing action! Grab the game now to try out the new song-levels and help defeat the Harm-Bots by lobbing pieces of cake at them!

Additionally, the price of the game has been reduced to only $5 so tell your friends to try it out. If you enjoy the game, please do consider leaving a review which helps us reach new players -- Merci beaux coup!

Lastly, the Rocococo game soundtrack is now on all streaming sites as well as bandcamp!

notes.title: Come play our game demo at Seattle Indies Expo during PAX on Sept 3rd!
notes.content:
[b]Rocococo Audiogame Fantastique[/b] will be giving live demos at the Motif Hotel on Sept 3rd from 12-9pm.  If you're in Seattle for PAX 2023, come on over to this free event and visit our booth for a demo --  playable by blind, visually-impaired, or sighted players!!

Visit https://six.seattleindies.org/ for more info

notes.title: Rocococo Audiogame Fantastique will be at Geek Girl Con 2023 in Seattle!
notes.content:
Rocococo Audiogame Fantastique is excited to be part of Geek Girl Con 2023 in Seattle on Oct 7 & 8 at the Seattle Convention Center’s Arch location. Come by to check out the game!

https://geekgirlcon.com/

GeekGirlCon takes place at Seattle Convention Center’s Arch at 800 Pike, located at 8th and Pike in downtown Seattle, WA, right across the street from the main Seattle Convention Center building.

Can't wait to share the progress of the game with you all at this event!
